title: hippolytia tomentosa
intro: Hippolytia tomentosa, commonly known as Himalayan Marsh Marigold, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is native to the mountainous regions of the Himalayas and is known for its bright yellow flowers and hairy leaves. The health benefits of Hippolytia tomentosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
